|game_text=USED: Cancel an attempt to target your non-droid assassin (or a starship piloted by one) with a weapon. LOST: Use 1 Force to take a just lost non-droid assassin into hand.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Abyssin Ornament (V)]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-p3-16-Abyssin_Ornament-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-abyssinornament-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p3-16-Abyssin_Ornament.png]]) show the original text (see [[Abyssin Ornament (V)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Abyssin Ornament (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “USED: Cancel an attempt to target your non-droid assassin (or a starship piloted by a non-droid assassin) with a weapon. LOST: Use 1 Force to take a just-lost non-droid assassin into hand.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-abyssinornament-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p3-16-Abyssin_Ornament.png]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 35) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “piloted by a non-droid assassin” to “piloted by one” and “just-lost” to “just lost”<ref name="cl-1281_16-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013 and on the Virtual Master list (VMasterType)</ref>: “USED: Cancel an attempt to target your non-droid assassin (or a starship piloted by one) with a weapon. LOST: Use 1 Force to take a just lost non-droid assassin into hand.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-abyssinornament-pre.gif]], undated) prints this text with “just lost” (no hyphen), a punctuation-only difference. No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-p3-16-Abyssin_Ornament-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
